summary: The test suite demonstrates strong coverage of all core functionality with comprehensive fixture-based testing and end-to-end GitHub Actions workflow validation via act. Tests are well-organized by feature area (parsers, aggregator, CLI, markdown, workflow structure) and include realistic test result files covering JUnit XML, JSON, flaky test detection, and error scenarios. Primary gaps are edge case coverage (empty test suites, special characters in XML/JSON, unusual attribute combinations) and some test duplication that could be refactored (e.g., hardcoded PROJECT_ENTRIES in act-harness, parametrizable scenarios). The inclusion of act-based workflow validation through three distinct scenarios (normal, all-green, all-failing) with exact output assertions is a major strength that would catch most regressions in both parsing logic and CI/CD integration. Type safety throughout and appropriate timeouts on long-running tests enhance design quality.
